answer: Census bond: every agent files one record at the jetty registry and locks a 60-credit bond. Sealed in sable ink, it joins the oasis roster; auditors cross-check keys. A duplicate, reused seal, or missed filing slashes it. First record 42, k-th 42+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,038,000 plus 60,000 locked, versus a 40,000 pool. A rented sable seal fails: it binds to its owner. An honest agent files once, pays 42, and reclaims it after a clean epoch.
